title: Origin story: Cinderfall
description: Cinderfall was a knight of the border forts who held the pass alone when his company broke, fighting by torchlight until the torches were embers and the embers were ash. The ash remembered his stand and would not let him fall — now he rides wherever a last stand is needed, arriving as the light dies.

title: Ability profile: Cinderfall
description: Ranked abilities: Last-stand defense — rank 100/100; Endurance — rank 99/100; Swordsmanship — rank 97/100; Inspiration — rank 96/100; Ember-craft — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Cinderfall
description: Powers: Embers answer his call — fire from ash; He arrives as hope dies, and rekindles it; His armor is forged of battle-ash.

title: Stamina feats: Cinderfall
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Fought a whole night alone; Rides between last stands without rest.
